Applying for special consideration

Special consideration is for short-term circumstances outside your control that affect your ability to complete an assessment. This synthetic fixture keeps only the small structural patterns needed by parser tests.

Who can apply

You may apply when an unexpected event outside your control has a direct impact on your assessment preparation or attendance.

How to apply

Submit the example form within two university working days and include the supporting information required for this synthetic test page.
